description: This Java class 'UrlImageBinder' binds image URLs from a Cursor to an ImageView by downloading the image from the internet. It extends a CursorBinder and utilizes an ImageDownloader for fetching images.

classes.name: UrlImageBinder
classes.description: A class that binds image URLs to ImageViews by downloading images from the internet, extending CursorBinder.

methods.name: UrlImageBinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UrlImageBinder with context and a transformation.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the URL from the cursor to the provided ImageView by downloading the image.
